ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels and 15% low-intensity (black/grey) pixels concentrated at margins and localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields on both lobes; solid black linear boundary along the superior trailing edge; heterogeneous dark pixel clusters (mottling) at the distal tips; scattered low-intensity punctate marks across the central-left and central-right regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 40 degrees; depth-to-width ratio of central depression is approximately 1:3.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with irregular peaks and valleys; average peak-to-peak distance is approximately 20-30 pixels; serrations are more pronounced on the outer two-thirds of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave parabolic curve following a downward trajectory from distal tips toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, roughly circular clusters of high-contrast pixels located at the terminal ends of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the white ventral surface, most prominent on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of significant scarring at the distal tips; parallel linear rake marks across the medial areas of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Individual high-contrast dark spot located in the upper-mid section of the left lobe.
